display_long_description:
The Most Addictive Music Challenge on Meta Horizon!

Get ready to move with Bouncy Beat: Tiles Hop Music. Combining fast-paced gameplay with a massive library of hit tracks, this game brings a unique twist to the rhythm-hop genre. Instead of a simple ball, you guide charming Kubiko characters through a fully immersive 3D environment. Your goal is simple: listen to the beat, time your jumps, and ensure your Kubiko never misses a tile!

Why You Will Love It:

Meet the Kubikos: Choose and control different stylized Kubiko characters, adding a fun and personality-filled layer to your rhythm experience.

Massive Music Library: Choose from a wide variety of high-quality tracks across different genres. Whether you like fast EDM or chill beats, there’s a song for every mood.

Rhythm-Sync Gameplay: Every hop is perfectly timed to the music, creating a deeply satisfying flow as you play in VR.

Dynamic 3D Visuals: Watch the world change and pulse along with the music. The high-contrast colors and stylized backgrounds make every song feel like a concert.

Simple & Intuitive Controls: Use your VR controllers to guide your Kubiko with precision. It’s easy to pick up but challenging to master as the tempo increases!

Put on your headset, pick your Kubiko, and let the music guide your movements. The tiles are waiting!
